messages:
Kai (AM): ArgonHealth RFP just arrived. they want a 21-day evaluation, EU-only hosting, and answers to a 110-question security pack. link: <https://drive.redwood.com/attachments/argon_rfp_v2.xlsx|argon_rfp_v2.xlsx>
Rina (SE): Scope: chat summarization + embeddings retrieval + reranking. They requested a capability matrix comparing hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.
Omar (Infra): For EU latency and 3-week POC, recommend 2 small dedicated nodes with autoscale and warm standby. quantized models to keep memory low.
Luz (Security): Questionnaire flags: KMS keys, HSM support, audit log retention, SOC2 docs, vulnerability scan cadence. Need to know if they'll send PHI.
Pete (Pricing): Draft POC pricing: $8k pro-rated for dedicated reserve + usage rate. add 24/7 on-call at $1.5k/wk. will model token tiers if they give volume.
Kai (AM): They estimate 2.5M tokens/day avg, 7M peak. also asked about fallback to smaller models for latency.
Rina (SE): Recommend primary redwood-llama-13b-quant, fallback redwood-llama-7b; embeddings use batch 128 and enable prefix caching. I'll update the matrix.
Omar (Infra): Example deploy manifest:
``
deploy: argon-poc-eu
pool: dedicated-eu-small
instances: 2
model: redwood-llama-13b-quant
autoscale: min=1 max=3 target_rps=100
```
Use KV cache and warm-warm standby.
Luz (Security): We can support customer-managed KMS for hosted; full HSM only on Private. default audit retention 90 days; extendable. I'll draft answers and attach SOC2.
rfi-bot: Uploaded argon_rfp_v2.xlsx (size: 430KB)
Maya (Legal): I'll review indemnity and data processing addendum. Kai, point me to contract tab.
Pete (Pricing): Action items: I'll prepare pro-rated ratecard (ETA 2h). Rina update capability matrix (ETA 3h). Luz finish security responses (ETA EOD). Omar propose perf test plan (ETA 6h). Maya review contract asks (ETA next AM). Kai to schedule internal send-off.
Kai (AM): Thanks team — target consolidated response by tomorrow COB.
